enemies.name: Rusthammer Warrior
enemies.flavour_text: 'Rusthammer' is a violent organization that has broken away from civilization to wander the wastelands. In these barren wastes, far from the comforts offered by nomadic city-states, life itself is an endless war.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked and is initially Invulnerable for a period of time
Periodically releases a special bolt that deals massive Arts damage

enemies.name: 'Frozen Monstrosity'
enemies.flavour_text: A Sami snowpriest went to the endless tundra to defend against the demons that invaded her homeland. In the end, she went insane and became a part of the tundra's curse.

abilities.text: Normal attacks and Ice Nova deal Arts damage and applies Cold to targets
If a target is defeated or retreats while Frozen, its Redeployment Time is doubled
Can activate Originium Ice Crystals around the battlefield

enemies.name: 'Gravestone'
enemies.flavour_text: A cruel murderer, an assassin that pursues you relentlessly. The violence bred in this land will eventually grow inside every perpetrator.

abilities.text: Halves the ATK and DEF of all your units on the battlefield; Halves natural DP regeneration rate; Doubles Redeployment Time
Periodically gains a Barrier proportional to Max HP.

enemies.name: Bone Sea Drifter
enemies.flavour_text: Sea Terrors travel in large swarms, seeking carcasses to feast on and becoming food for other Sea Terrors themselves.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.

enemies.name: Ocean Stonecutter
enemies.flavour_text: Sea Terror with a hard shell, protecting the swarm from enemies.

abilities.text: When your units enter its attack range for the first time, temporarily stops moving and gains increased DEF.

enemies.name: Retching Broodmother
enemies.flavour_text: Sea Terror mothers that throw fake offspring at oncoming threats, allowing the true offspring to flee.

abilities.text: Can only attack ground targets
Summons 1 <Baleful Broodling> near the target when dealing damage

enemies.name: Baleful Broodling
enemies.flavour_text: An extension of the broodmother's body, identical to newly-born offspring.

abilities.text: Unable to move
Gradually loses HP over time
Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.

enemies.name: Skimming Sea Drifter
enemies.flavour_text: Some Sea Terrors have begun to adapt to the sky, able to glide above the waves for extended periods. Perhaps this branch will eventually evolve to make their home in the heavens.

abilities.text: Low-Altitude Hovering
Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.

enemies.name: Saint Carmen
enemies.flavour_text: The last surviving Saint of Iberia, living well past mortal life expectancy. His longevity came at a price, but he remembers his duty and his enemies, despite having lost his reason.

abilities.text: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and deal a large amount of Physical damage. Ammo capacity: 3
If reloading is interrupted, becomes Stunned for an additional period of time

enemies.name: Saint Iberia
enemies.flavour_text: The last surviving Saint of Iberia, living well past mortal life expectancy. His longevity came at a price, but he will hunt Iberia's enemies for as long as the flame of his life still burns.

abilities.text: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and deal a large amount of Physical damage. Ammo capacity: 1
If reloading is interrupted, becomes Stunned for an additional period of time
Has higher HP and ATK

enemies.name: Tidelinked Bishop
enemies.flavour_text: A bishop that has partially mutated. It is partly human, partly—

abilities.text: When its Other Half is alive and not in coma, enters a coma when HP reaches 0 and begins regenerating; revives when HP reaches max.

enemies.name: Tidelinked Archon
enemies.flavour_text: —Sea Terror. Even Ægir technology has a role to play in the evolution of we many.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.
When its Other Half is alive and not in coma, enters a coma when HP reaches 0 and begins regenerating; revives when HP reaches max.

enemies.name: Tidelinked Immortal
enemies.flavour_text: —Sea Terror. The product of both technology and evolutionary instincts.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict additional Corrosion.
When its Other Half is alive and not in coma, enters a coma when HP reaches 0 and begins regenerating fast; revives when HP reaches max
Has lower HP and ATK, but higher ASPD and Movement Speed

enemies.name: Pathshaper
enemies.flavour_text: Seaborn tasked with exploring evolutionary pathways, its fractals mapping out dead ends so that we many can stay on the right path.

abilities.text: Every 3rd attack summons a <Pathshaper Fractal>
Summons 1 <Pathshaper Fractal> after taking a number of attacks

enemies.name: Lingering Pathshaper
enemies.flavour_text: Seaborn tasked with exploring evolutionary pathways. Its injuries and those suffered by its fractals become a guide for the evolution of we many.

abilities.text: Every 3rd attack summons a <Pathshaper Fractal>
Summons 1 <Pathshaper Fractal> after taking a few attacks
Has lower ASPD, but higher HP

enemies.name: Pathshaper Fractal
enemies.flavour_text: Fractals left behind by the Seaborn Pathshaper. Illusions must eventually vanish. The path is not clear. Search on, search on.

abilities.text: Dies after some time
Every 3rd attack summons a <Pathshaper Fractal>

enemies.name: Crying Thief
enemies.flavour_text: A Perro who left his family to seek out a new life... but all that people know is that he is always weeping.

abilities.text: Invisible
Attacks Stun the target

enemies.name: Chest Seaborn
enemies.flavour_text: Sea Terror disguised as a treasure chest, often used by Bishops of the Deep to protect hideouts.

enemies.name: Cannot
enemies.flavour_text: A mysterious trader who roams the barrenlands, selling anything that exists in civilization.

abilities.text: Cannot be attacked, will not deplete Life Points on leaving the field
Periodically releases random chemicals that affect the battlefield

enemies.name: 'Paranoia Illusion'
enemies.flavour_text: An Ægir girl who went out of control after ingesting Seaborn cells. Her throat makes no voice, for the prayers of we many have blocked it. She is drowned in power, becoming what she once detested the most.

abilities.text: First Form
Low-Altitude Hovering
All allied units within attack range have greatly reduced ASPD
Attacks up to 3 targets at the same time, inflicting additional Corrosion. Can attack a target multiple times if the number of targets is less than maximum
Second Form
Attack Range expands, ASPD reduction is increased, and can attack up to 5 targets

enemies.name: The Last Knight
enemies.flavour_text: The basis of a well-known folk tale in Kazimierz. The past died on the land, and neither the present nor the future have any meaning. Only the ocean; kill the ocean.

abilities.text: Initial Form
When damaged, inflicts Cold on the source. Effect increased if HP is below 50%
Attack power increases when attacking Frozen targets
The first time HP drops to 0, enters Charging Form
Charging Form
Cannot be blocked.

enemies.name: Ishar'mla, Heart of Corruption
enemies.flavour_text: She sings no more. It speaks for we many.

abilities.text: Initial Form
Regular attacks heal 3 enemies simultaneously
Periodically summons <Ishar'mla's Tears> to charge itself. Transforms once fully charged
When HP drops below 50%, gains greatly increased ATK, and summons 2 additional <Ishar'mla's Tears>
Transformed Form
Attacks deal True damage to 3 targets simultaneously

enemies.name: Ishar'mla's Tears
enemies.flavour_text: Manifestation of Ishar'mla's explorative and combative nature.

abilities.text: Appears around your units
Periodically deals True damage. If there are no targets within attack range, charges up <Ishar'mla, Heart of Corruption>
Disappears when <Ishar'mla, Heart of Corruption> transforms

enemies.name: Izumik's Offspring
enemies.flavour_text: One of Izumik's evolutionary branches, bringing genetic data collected across Terra back to the mother.

abilities.text: Becomes a random enemy when blocked.

enemies.name: Izumik, Source of Ecology
enemies.flavour_text: A perfect organism, approaching an evolutionary singularity. The pioneer and guide of we many. The last first-born. Seaborn.

abilities.text: Learning Stage
Cannot be attacked, HP and ATK increase permanently after absorbing a certain number of <Izumik's Offspring>, and deals Arts damage to all allied units
Enters Interpretation Stage after some time, or if HP reaches max
Interpretation Stage
Attacks deal additional Arts damage
Inflicts Stun and Arts damage over time to all allied units whenever it loses a certain amount of HP, or after a period of time

enemies.name: Fatty
enemies.flavour_text: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue. Frequently appears on dubious TV shows, preaching about how he cares little for losses or gains, as they are part of the natural money-making process.

abilities.text: Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.
